wish: someone should make a tool that tries many decoders on a mystery string
spec:
Runs a pasted string through 17 decoders (base64, base32, hex, binary, octal, decimal, A1Z26, URL, HTML entities, escapes, quoted-printable, morse, JWT, atbash, rot47, reverse, best Caesar shift) plus gzip/zlib inside base64, and every two-step chain of them.
Paste the string; readable results are ranked first with a score, each can be copied or fed back in with 'decode this'.
It does not crack encryption or hashes (MD5, SHA, AES) and sends nothing anywhere.
